prompt:
Create ONE vertical portrait (2:3) promotional image for a WhatsApp Status of Tasaji Food, a premium halal frozen food brand from Indonesia. Audience: Indonesian mothers. Mood: mouth-watering, warm, irresistible - the cooked dish must make viewers instantly hungry. NOT a discount poster: no prices, no badges.

PRODUCT & SCENE: attached is the actual packaging photo of Tasaji frozen roti maryam (layered flatbread), packaging has the Tasaji brand label. Build a lifestyle scene with TWO elements:
1. THE COOKED DISH: freshly pan-toasted roti maryam: round layered flatbread, golden brown, flaky, one piece torn showing soft stretchy thin layers inside, butter melting on top, honey drizzle on the side, steam rising.
2. THE PACKAGING: standing upright, appearing EXACTLY as in the source photo.
BALANCED COMPOSITION: the packaging and the cooked dish must be EQUAL partners - same visual size and prominence, side by side (packaging left, dish right, or symmetrical arrangement). Neither may dominate or shrink - it is PLAIN transparent packaging, LEAVE IT PLAIN, do NOT add any logo, label, sticker or writing on it.

DESIGN: warm Indonesian home kitchen/dining ambience, softly blurred. CONDIMENT RULE (strict): supporting props must be condiments/companions that Indonesians GENUINELY eat with THIS specific product. Maximum 2-3 items. For this product use ONLY: a small bowl of honey with dipper, and grated cheese or melted chocolate on the side. FORBIDDEN for this product: sambal, chili, lime, savory garnish - they do not match a sweet flatbread. Rich warm colors, dramatic appetizing light, professional food-ad photography.

TEXT TO RENDER (exactly these words, nothing else, perfect Indonesian spelling):
1. THE BIGGEST text, top area (this is the star, big bold characterful typography, cream/white with warm orange accent): "Sarapan besok beres, tinggal panggang"
2. Small product name under it: "Roti Maryam Original - Tasaji Food"
3. Bottom area, clear and readable on a subtle dark strip, two items: phone number "0877-7513-3443" and website "tasajifood.com"
No call-to-action button. No other text anywhere. All text spelled EXACTLY as written, especially the phone number digits.

NO HUMANS: no people, hands, or faces.

COMPOSITION: vertical portrait, headline top, cooked dish dominant center, packaging supporting, phone number bottom. No watermark.
